result:
I’d make perspective-taking involuntary and accurate: every person would automatically feel the real consequences of their choices from the perspective of those affected—not as guilt, just as perception.

Most cruelty, neglect, and institutional indifference depend on distance and abstraction. Remove that distance, and it becomes much harder to treat people as statistics, enemies, or inconveniences. It wouldn’t make everyone agree, but it would make it far harder to harm people casually.
